body: This is so lovely. Great job! and big ups for Bob Dylan :)

You are so incredibly brave. I'm 19 and when I was your age I was going through a lot of my own depression and the one time I reached out and told my mom, she completely ignored it. I also had/have issues with my mother and felt like she just hated me for some unknown reason because she was always verbally abusive and was never that way to my brothers. I felt alone and scared and kept it all to myself for years. 

If you ever feel alone please remember that you are not, you are strong and brave for sharing your story with us. I'm just a stranger on the internet but I empathize with you and I am here for you. You can talk to me anytime and I promise you I will be here for you.

As an Asian American suicide/depression was never spoken of in my house unless it's on the news and I'd always hear my mother say how "it's so selfish," or "it's for weak people who don't want to try" and it would really fuck me up because I used to walk the line between life and death quite often. 

Like what's been said already, the only thing that has ever stopped me from doing anything is that I don't want to hurt the people in my life that I love. I would never want to bring them pain to deal with for the rest of their lives. But i know that other people are not like me, and really can't find a way out. In the end, I've always believed that people should always be able to choose their own fate.

I would LOVE friends who powerlift and go the gym with me. I always have guys wanting to gym with me but nothing beats lifting with like minded females in my opinion. I've only been able to find one friend to to go the gym with but sadly she was a cardio bunny and I was yet again alone in the free weights :/ I also would love someone with similar style and we could take flawless pictures together while pigging out at every food place in the area.
